verses.en: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the LORD, mine horn is exalted in the LORD: my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; because I rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.pt: Então Ana orou, dizendo: O meu coração exulta no Senhor; o meu poder está exaltado no Senhor; a minha boca dilata-se contra os meus imimigos, porquanto me regozijo na tua salvação.
verses.en_web: Hannah prayed, and said: “My heart exults in Yahweh! My horn is exalted in Yahweh. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.
verses.en_bbe: And Hannah, in prayer before the Lord, said, My heart is glad in the Lord, my horn is lifted up in the Lord: my mouth is open wide over my haters; because my joy is in your salvation.

verses.en: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.
verses.pt: Ninguém há santo como o Senhor; não há outro fora de ti; não há rocha como a nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, For there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.
verses.en_bbe: No other is holy as the Lord, for there is no other God but you: there is no Rock like our God.

verses.en: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
verses.pt: Não faleis mais palavras tão altivas, nem saia da vossa boca a arrogância; porque o Senhor é o Deus da sabedoria, e por ele são pesadas as ações.
verses.en_web: “Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, For Yahweh is a God of knowledge. By him actions are weighed.
verses.en_bbe: Say no more words of pride; let not uncontrolled sayings come out of your mouths: for the Lord is a God of knowledge, by him acts are judged.

verses.en: The bows of the mighty men are broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.
verses.pt: Os arcos dos fortes estão quebrados, e os fracos são cingidos de força.
verses.en_web: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.
verses.en_bbe: The bows of the men of war are broken, and the feeble are clothed with strength.

verses.en: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren hath born seven; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble.
verses.pt: Os que eram fartos se alugam por pão, e deixam de ter fome os que eram famintos; até a estéril teve sete filhos, e a que tinha muitos filhos enfraquece.
verses.en_web: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes.
verses.en_bbe: Those who were full are offering themselves as servants for bread; those who were in need are at rest; truly, she who had no children has become the mother of seven; and she who had a family is wasted with sorrow.

verses.en: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.
verses.pt: O Senhor é o que tira a vida e a dá; faz descer ao Seol e faz subir dali.
verses.en_web: “Yahweh kills, and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol, and brings up.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is the giver of death and life: sending men down to the underworld and lifting them up.

verses.en: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.
verses.pt: O Senhor empobrece e enriquece; abate e também exalta.
verses.en_web: Yahweh makes poor, and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord gives wealth and takes a man's goods from him: crushing men down and again lifting them up;

verses.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD’S, and he hath set the world upon them.
verses.pt: Levanta do pó o pobre, do monturo eleva o necessitado, para os fazer sentar entre os príncipes, para os fazer herdar um trono de glória; porque do Senhor são as colunas da terra, sobre elas pôs ele o mundo.
verses.en_web: He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill, To make them sit with princes, and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are Yahweh’s. He has set the world on them.
verses.en_bbe: Lifting the poor out of the dust, and him who is in need out of the lowest place, to give them their place among rulers, and for their heritage the seat of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the Lord's and he has made them the base of the world.

verses.en: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.
verses.pt: Ele guardará os pés dos seus santos, porém os ímpios ficarão mudos nas trevas, porque o homem não prevalecerá pela força.
verses.en_web: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked shall be put to silence in darkness; for no man shall prevail by strength.
verses.en_bbe: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the evil-doers will come to their end in the dark night, for by strength no man will overcome.

verses.en: The adversaries of the LORD shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: the LORD shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength unto his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.
verses.pt: Os que contendem com o Senhor serão quebrantados; desde os céus trovejará contra eles. O Senhor julgará as extremidades da terra; dará força ao seu rei, e exaltará o poder do seu ungido.
verses.en_web: Those who strive with Yahweh shall be broken to pieces. He will thunder against them in the sky. “Yahweh will judge the ends of the earth. He will give strength to his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.”
verses.en_bbe: Those who make war against the Lord will be broken; against them he will send his thunder from heaven: the Lord will be judge of the ends of the earth, he will give strength to his king, lifting up the horn of him on whom the holy oil has been put.

verses.en: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the LORD before Eli the priest.
verses.pt: Então Elcana se retirou a Ramá, à sua casa. O menino, porém, ficou servindo ao Senhor perante e sacerdote Eli.
verses.en_web: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served Yahweh before Eli the priest.
verses.en_bbe: Then Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child became the servant of the Lord under the direction of Eli the priest.

verses.en: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the LORD.
verses.pt: Ora, os filhos de Eli eram homens ímpios; não conheciam ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Now the sons of Eli were evil and good-for-nothing men, having no knowledge of the Lord.

verses.en: And the priest’s custom with the people was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest’s servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;
verses.pt: Porquanto o costume desses sacerdotes para com o povo era que, oferecendo alguém um sacrifício, e estando-se a cozer a carne, vinha o servo do sacerdote, tendo na mão um garfo de três dentes,
verses.en_web: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;
verses.en_bbe: And the priests' way with the people was this: when any man made an offering, the priest's servant came while the flesh was being cooked, having in his hand a meat-hook with three teeth;

verses.en: And he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.
verses.pt: e o metia na panela, ou no tacho, ou no caldeirão, ou na marmita; e tudo quanto a garfo tirava, o sacerdote tomava para si. Assim faziam a todos os de Israel que chegavam ali em Siló.
verses.en_web: and he stabbed it into the pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself. So they did in Shiloh to all the Israelites who came there.
verses.en_bbe: This he put into the pot, and everything which came up on the hook the priest took for himself. This they did in Shiloh to all the Israelites who came there.

verses.en: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.
verses.pt: Também, antes de queimarem a gordura, vinha o servo do sacerdote e dizia ao homem que sacrificava: Dá carne de assar para o sacerdote; porque não receberá de ti carne cozida, mas crua.
verses.en_web: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”
verses.en_bbe: And more than this, before the fat was burned, the priest's servant would come and say to the man who was making the offering, Give me some of the flesh to be cooked for the priest; he has no taste for meat cooked in water, but would have you give it uncooked.

verses.en: And if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and then take as much as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him, Nay; but thou shalt give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.
verses.pt: se lhe respondia o homem: Sem dúvida, logo há de ser queimada a gordura e depois toma quanto desejar a tua alma; então ele lhe dizia: Não hás de dá-la agora; se não, à força a tomarei.
verses.en_web: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires”; then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”
verses.en_bbe: And if the man said to him, First let the fat be burned, then take as much as you will; then the servant would say, No, you are to give it to me now, or I will take it by force.

verses.en: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD: for men abhorred the offering of the LORD.
verses.pt: Era, pois, muito grande o pecado destes mancebos perante o Senhor, porquanto os homens vieram a desprezar a oferta do Senhor.
verses.en_web: The sin of the young men was very great before Yahweh; for the men despised the offering of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And the sin of these young men was very great before the Lord; for they gave no honour to the Lord's offerings.

verses.en: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.
verses.pt: Samuel, porém, ministrava perante o Senhor, sendo ainda menino, vestido de um éfode de linho.
verses.en_web: But Samuel ministered before Yahweh, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.
verses.en_bbe: But Samuel did the work of the Lord's house, while he was a child, dressed in a linen ephod.

verses.en: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verses.pt: E sua mãe lhe fazia de ano em ano uma túnica pequena, e lha trazia quando com seu marido subia para oferecer o sacrifício anual.
verses.en_web: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verses.en_bbe: And his mother made him a little robe and took it to him every year when she came with her husband for the year's offering.

verses.en: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the LORD. And they went unto their own home.
verses.pt: Então Eli abençoava a Elcana e a sua mulher, e dizia: O Senhor te dê desta mulher descendência, pelo empréstimo que fez ao Senhor. E voltavam para o seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May Yahweh give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of Yahweh.” Then they went to their own home.
verses.en_bbe: And every year Eli gave Elkanah and his wife a blessing, saying, May the Lord give you offspring by this woman in exchange for the child you have given to the Lord. And they went back to their house.

verses.en: And the LORD visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.
verses.pt: Visitou, pois, o Senhor a Ana, que concebeu, e teve três filhos e duas filhas. Entrementes, o menino Samuel crescia diante do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Yahweh visited Hannah, and she conceived, and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord had mercy on Hannah and she gave birth to three sons and two daughters. And the young Samuel became older before the Lord.

verses.en: Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did unto all Israel; and how they lay with the women that assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.pt: Eli era já muito velho; e ouvia tudo quanto seus filhos faziam a todo o Israel, e como se deitavam com as mulheres que ministravam à porta da tenda da revelação.
verses.en_web: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how that they slept with the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.en_bbe: Now Eli was very old; and he had news from time to time of what his sons were doing to all Israel.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.
verses.pt: E disse-lhes: Por que fazeis tais coisas? pois ouço de todo este povo os vossos malefícios.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? for I hear of your evil dealings from all this people.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Why are you doing such things? for from all this people I get accounts of your evil ways.

verses.en: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear: ye make the LORD’S people to transgress.
verses.pt: Não, filhos meus, não é boa fama esta que ouço. Fazeis transgredir o povo do Senhor.
verses.en_web: No, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear! You make Yahweh’s people disobey.
verses.en_bbe: No, my sons, the account which is given me, which the Lord's people are sending about, is not good.

verses.en: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against the LORD, who shall intreat for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the LORD would slay them.
verses.pt: Se um homem pecar contra outro, Deus o julgará; mas se um homem pecar contra o Senhor, quem intercederá por ele? Todavia eles não ouviram a voz de seu pai, porque o Senhor os queria destruir.
verses.en_web: If one man sins against another, God will judge him; but if a man sins against Yahweh, who will intercede for him?” Notwithstanding, they didn’t listen to the voice of their father, because Yahweh intended to kill them.
verses.en_bbe: If one man does wrong to another, God will be his judge: but if a man's sin is against the Lord, who will take up his cause? But they gave no attention to the voice of their father, for it was the Lord's purpose to send destruction on them.

verses.en: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the LORD, and also with men.
verses.pt: E o menino Samuel ia crescendo em estatura e em graça diante do Senhor, como também diante dos homens.
verses.en_web: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Yahweh, and also with men.
verses.en_bbe: And the young Samuel, becoming older, had the approval of the Lord and of men.

verses.en: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh’s house?
verses.pt: Veio um homem de Deus a Eli, e lhe disse: Assim diz o Senhor: Não me revelei, na verdade, à casa de teu pai, estando eles ainda no Egito, sujeitos à casa de Faraó?
verses.en_web: A man of God came to Eli, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father, when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?
verses.en_bbe: And a man of God came to Eli and said to him, The Lord says, Did I let myself be seen by your father's people when they were in Egypt, servants in Pharaoh's house?

verses.en: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to offer upon mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel?
verses.pt: E eu o escolhi dentre todas as tribos de Israel para ser o meu sacerdote, para subir ao meu altar, para queimar o incenso, e para trazer o éfode perante mim; e dei à casa de teu pai todas as ofertas queimadas dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Didn’t I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? Didn’t I give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?
verses.en_bbe: Did I take him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest and to go up to my altar to make the smoke of the offerings go up and to take up the ephod? Did I give to your father's family all the offerings made by fire by the children of Israel?

verses.en: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded in my habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?
verses.pt: Por que desprezais o meu sacrifício e a minha oferta, que ordenei se fizessem na minha morada, e por que honras a teus filhos mais de que a mim, de modo a vos engordardes do principal de todas as ofertas do meu povo Israel?
verses.en_web: Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel my people?’
verses.en_bbe: Why then are you looking with envy on my offerings of meat and of meal which were ordered by my word, honouring your sons before me, and making yourselves fat with all the best of the offerings of Israel, my people?

verses.en: Wherefore the LORD God of Israel saith, I said indeed that thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before me for ever: but now the LORD saith, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.
verses.pt: Portanto, diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Na verdade eu tinha dito que a tua casa e a casa de teu pai andariam diante de mim perpetuamente. Mas agora o Senhor diz: Longe de mim tal coisa, porque honrarei aos que me honram, mas os que me desprezam serão desprezados.
verses.en_web: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house, and the house of your father, should walk before me forever.’ But now Yahweh says, ‘Far be it from me; for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me will be cursed.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason the Lord God of Israel has said, Truly I did say that your family and your father's people would have their place before me for ever: but now the Lord says, Let it not be so; I will give honour to those by whom I am honoured, and those who have no respect for me will be of small value in my eyes.

verses.en: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father’s house, that there shall not be an old man in thine house.
verses.pt: Eis que vêm dias em que cortarei o teu braço e o braço da casa de teu pai, para que não haja mais ancião algum em tua casa.
verses.en_web: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off your arm, and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old man in your house.
verses.en_bbe: See, the days are coming when your arm and the arm of your father's people will be cut off;

verses.en: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation, in all the wealth which God shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever.
verses.pt: E tu, na angústia, olharás com inveja toda a prosperidade que hei de trazer sobre Israel; e não haverá por todos os dias ancião algum em tua casa.
verses.en_web: You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel; and there shall not be an old man in your house forever.
verses.en_bbe: And never again will there be an old man in your family.

verses.en: And the man of thine, whom I shall not cut off from mine altar, shall be to consume thine eyes, and to grieve thine heart: and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age.
verses.pt: O homem da tua linhagem a quem eu não desarraigar do meu altar será para consumir-te os olhos e para entristecer-te a alma; e todos es descendentes da tua casa morrerão pela espada dos homens.
verses.en_web: The man of yours, whom I don’t cut off from my altar, will consume your eyes and grieve your heart; and all the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.
verses.en_bbe: But one man of your family will not be cut off by my hand, and his eyes will be made dark, and grief will be in his heart: and all the offspring of your family will come to their end by the sword of men.

verses.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.
verses.pt: E te será por sinal o que sobrevirá a teus dois filhos, a Hofni e a Finéias; ambos morrerão no mesmo dia.
verses.en_web: “‘This will be the sign to you, that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.
verses.en_bbe: And this will be the sign to you, which will come on Hophni and Phinehas, your sons; death will overtake them on the same day.

verses.en: And I will raise me up a faithful priest, that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever.
verses.pt: E eu suscitarei para mim um sacerdote fiel, que fará segundo o que está no meu coração e na minha mente. Edificar-lhe-ei uma casa duradoura, e ele andará sempre diante de meu ungido.
verses.en_web: I will raise me up a faithful priest, that will do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind. I will build him a sure house; and he will walk before my anointed forever.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make a true priest for myself, one who will do what is in my heart and in my mind: and I will make for him a family which will not come to an end; and his place will be before my holy one for ever.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a piece of bread.
verses.pt: Também todo aquele que ficar de resto da tua casa virá a inclinar-se diante dele por uma moeda de prata e por um pedaço de pão, e dirá: Rogo-te que me admitas a algum cargo sacerdotal, para que possa comer um bocado de pão.
verses.en_web: It will happen, that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread, and will say, “Please put me into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a morsel of bread.”’”
verses.en_bbe: Then it will be that the rest of your family, anyone who has not been cut off, will go down on his knees to him for a bit of silver or a bit of bread, and say, Be pleased to put me into one of the priest's places so that I may have a little food.
